pages.title: Supermarket Management Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run a growing grocery business in Supermarket Management Simulator. Keep shelves supplied with the products customers need and expand the shop as you work. Preparing ingredients for fresh bread adds another task alongside restocking and managing the store's selection.

pages.title: Trucktopolis Cooking Chaos
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Trucktopolis Cooking Chaos puts you behind a food-truck counter serving dishes in several countries. Prepare orders before customers lose patience, meet daily goals, and unlock recipes. Kitchen upgrades help you handle the rush as more orders arrive.

pages.title: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Logic Storm: Animals Puzzle asks you to place animals on a colored grid under overlapping rules. Every row, column, and color region needs exactly one animal, and animals cannot touch. Use those restrictions together to determine where each animal belongs.

pages.title: Two Stunt Supercars
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive a customizable supercar through a stunt city in Two Stunt Supercars. Explore three driving modes or challenge a friend in two-player competitions. Separate keyboard controls let both drivers take part as you test your handling around the city.

pages.title: Ice Cube
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Race a ninety-second clock in Ice Cube by clearing groups of at least three same-colored blocks. Larger groups earn more points, while a filled gauge produces score multipliers. Collect bombs and line-clearing power-ups, and avoid clicking isolated blocks that incur penalties.

pages.title: Dino Hide N Shoot
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dino Hide N Shoot mixes dinosaur combat with moving between attacks. Run to avoid the creature, gather ammunition, and use boxes as cover. Build up your firepower, then pick a safe opening to shoot before the next attack arrives.

pages.title: Royal Garden Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Restore a castle garden through match-three puzzles in Royal Garden Match. Swap flowers, fruit, and plants to collect the items shown in each level's task panel. Work within the move allowance, creating and combining boosters through longer matches.

pages.title: Sniper Freeze
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Sniper Freeze asks you to shoot players who break a movement rule. Activate the freeze, then aim at the rule-breakers highlighted in red and release to fire. Shooting someone who stayed still causes a loss, so identification matters alongside accuracy.

pages.title: Football Fun
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Take part in three-a-side matches in Football Fun. Pass, shoot, steal possession, and switch players as you try to outscore the opposition. Earnings and progression connect to a shop offering additional balls and stadiums, with a leaderboard for stronger performances.

pages.title: Tanks. Race for survival
pages.creator: Crazy Pixel
pages.description: Tanks. Race for survival sends armed vehicles toward a shared finish line. Drive past obstacles and destroy hostile towers while avoiding attacks and traps. Choose your route carefully as you compete with other tanks to reach the end first.

pages.title: Noob: Zombie Prison Escape
pages.creator: Godplex
pages.description: Escape an undead-filled prison in Noob: Zombie Prison Escape. Find keys, solve puzzles, and cross platforms while avoiding traps. A crossbow helps deal with monsters, while torch tasks and parkour obstacles add further challenges on the route out.

pages.title: Sort Mart
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Reorganize shop shelves in Sort Mart until each product type is grouped correctly. Move items only beside matching products and respect each shelf's capacity. Limited space makes the order of your transfers important, while faster solutions earn higher scores.

pages.title: Crazy Chicken Jump
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Guide a jumping chicken around obstacles in Crazy Chicken Jump. Shift left and right with mouse or swipe controls to find a clear route through each puzzle. Thirty levels put different hazards in the chicken's path as you work toward completing the course.

pages.title: Death Dungeon - Survivor
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Survive approaching ghosts in Death Dungeon - Survivor. Move to evade the crowd and collect experience to level up. Each level increase gives you a skill choice, letting you develop your abilities as the survival run becomes more crowded.

pages.title: Birds Hex Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Rebuild bird pictures from hexagonal pieces in Birds Hex Jigsaw. Arrange the sections to restore the original image before the time limit expires. Two modes each offer a separate set of levels, changing the puzzle sequence you work through.

pages.title: Cute Witch Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Give princesses Halloween makeovers in Cute Witch Princess. Apply makeup, pick a hairstyle, and coordinate a witch outfit with a robe, pointed hat, and footwear. Add accessories to complete each character's transformation for the holiday celebration.

pages.title: Avoid You Dying
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Avoid You Dying makes target practice a matter of survival. Hit the target to complete each challenge, because missing triggers a massive falling weight. Each shot demands careful aim when failure brings an immediate threat from above.

pages.title: Steam Rocket
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Rebuild a broken spacecraft in Steam Rocket after becoming stranded on an alien planet. Use a jetpack to recover the rocket's parts, then fuel its boiler with coal for launch. Manage the flight while avoiding obstacles and trying to improve your score.

pages.title: Medieval Battle 2P
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Arrange soldiers for simulated medieval combat in Medieval Battle 2P. Place units, adjust their positions, and observe how your battle plan performs. Play alone or with another person, using the movable camera to inspect the battlefield and organize the forces.

pages.title: Rotating Square
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Rotating Square is a skill game about steering a square to catch yellow balls. Adjust its position as the targets appear and keep lining it up for another catch. Mouse or touch controls handle the movement throughout the challenge.

pages.title: Mermaids Tail Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Extend an underwater character's tail in Mermaids Tail Rush. Slide along the route to gather colored tail sections, making the mermaid's tail longer. Avoid obstacles that cut away your progress before you reach the end of the run.

pages.title: Friday Night Funkin Music Notes
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find concealed musical symbols in Friday Night Funkin Music Notes. Each picture contains ten notes to locate before time expires. Repeated mistakes cost additional seconds, so inspect the scenes carefully as you advance through the eight levels.

pages.title: The Mergest Kingdom
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Restore a fantasy realm in The Mergest Kingdom by combining objects into improved versions. Harvest resources, grow plants, and merge pieces into larger buildings. Complete quests while arranging an island of your own as the kingdom gradually takes shape.

pages.title: Jump The Birds
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Launch a bird between platforms in Jump The Birds. Hold and release to control each jump, collecting coins as you climb. Choose missions with specific tasks or try endless mode, where the aim is to keep reaching more platforms.

pages.title: Persia Prince Dash
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Guide an armored prince through dungeon puzzles in Persia Prince Dash. Move around the layout, gather gold coins, and work out a route through the chamber. Keyboard or mouse input controls the prince as you try to complete each dungeon challenge.

pages.title: Bullet Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Clear infected islands in Bullet Rush by shooting their green monsters. Move through the crowds toward the aircraft pickup area, then continue to another island. Improve your weapon between encounters as the mission takes you through further infested locations.

pages.title: Neon Invaders
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Neon Invaders sends formations of enemies toward your ship. Move into firing position and shoot them before they can reach you. Clear each wave to advance, accumulating points through an arcade campaign presented with brightly colored neon graphics.

pages.title: Idle Lumberjack 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Cut a path out of a wooded valley in Idle Lumberjack 3D. Fell the trees blocking your route and gather timber as you move through the forest. The wood also supports improvements to your home, linking clearing work with building upgrades.

pages.title: Ragdoll Shooter
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Face a physics-driven gun duel in Ragdoll Shooter. Time your mouse input to aim and fire when the weapon lines up with the opponent. The ragdoll movement changes the confrontation, making the moment you choose to shoot especially important.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Back To School
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare a school outfit in Dotted Girl Back To School. Compare modern clothing with classic uniform styles, choosing skirts or trousers and coordinating the rest of the look. Create a complete appearance for the character's return to class.

pages.title: Baby Princess Mia Bathe
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Baby Princess Mia Bathe follows a bath-time care routine and a dress-up session. Use soap, shampoo, and water to wash the character, then choose clothing and accessories. Work through the available care steps before putting together her finished outfit.

pages.title: Gold Truck Crane
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Operate a gold-collecting crane in Gold Truck Crane. Retrieve enough valuable pieces to reach the level's points requirement before time expires. Larger chunks help you meet the target sooner, making the choice and timing of each grab important.

pages.title: School Bus Difference
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Compare paired vehicle pictures in School Bus Difference and select the details that do not match. Scan each scene carefully while keeping track of the timer. The challenge depends on locating small alterations between otherwise similar bus illustrations.

pages.title: Green Ninja Run
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Guide a green-clad runner toward the finish in Green Ninja Run. Jump across platforms, avoid bullets, and deal with enemies blocking the route. Keep the path clear while navigating the gaps and attacks that separate the ninja from the goal.

pages.title: Super Ninja Adventure
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Collect the shuriken and find the exit in Super Ninja Adventure. Use the arrow keys to guide the ninja across platforms while avoiding traps. Each level requires both gathering its collectibles and reaching the door to complete the escape.

pages.title: Kids Color Candy
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Rotate a colored circle to catch matching sweets in Kids Color Candy. Turn it left or right so each incoming candy meets the correct section. A single mismatched catch ends the attempt, making every adjustment part of preserving the run.

pages.title: Army Tank Driving Simulation Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a tank along difficult tracks in Army Tank Driving Simulation Game. Keep the vehicle on the track as you work through the driving challenge. The game focuses on handling a heavy vehicle across routes where steering errors can interrupt your progress.

pages.title: Fast Food Restaurant
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Handle fast-food service in Fast Food Restaurant, a cooking game built around time management. Use the mouse to work through the restaurant's kitchen activities and keep the service moving. The challenge centers on managing cooking tasks during a busy shift.

pages.title: Jet Ski Racing Games: Water Boat mania
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Choose a water scooter and race across the course in Jet Ski Racing Games: Water Boat mania. Steer your craft through the aquatic racing setting and compete to win. The challenge centers on controlling your selected vehicle throughout the race.

pages.title: Happy Easter Memory
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Turn over pairs of Easter egg cards in Happy Easter Memory. Remember the pictures you reveal and use that knowledge to locate matching pairs. Each move exposes two cards, gradually giving you the information needed to clear the arrangement.

pages.title: Word Nature Connect
pages.creator: GameJuice
pages.description: Discover hidden words in Word Nature Connect by joining the displayed letters. Swipe through them in different orders to build the requested words. With no timer pressing you, the puzzle is about finding useful letter combinations and completing the missing answers.

pages.title: Ice Princess Resurrection Emergency
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Care for a princess in the hospital simulation Ice Princess Resurrection Emergency. Follow the game's prompts through an emergency sequence involving chest compressions and a defibrillator, then continue with her recovery tasks. The activity centers on completing each illustrated care step.

pages.title: Bloom
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Collect weapons and battle opponents in Bloom. Move around the arena to gather guns and build your fighting strength while other combatants threaten your character. The game tracks kills as you maneuver, shoot, and try to keep your fighter alive.

pages.title: Hero Ninja
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Rescue a captured friend in Hero Ninja by confronting the bad guys holding him. Use the mouse to carry out the ninja's actions and work toward freeing the prisoner. The rescue objective gives the encounter its focus as you deal with the enemies.

pages.title: Animal Shapes
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match four animals to their silhouettes in Animal Shapes. Compare the outline of each shadow with the available creatures, then place every animal in its corresponding shape. Completing all four matches finishes the level and clears that set of figures.

pages.title: Candies All The Way
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shift entire rows and columns in Candies All The Way to align matching sweets. Form lines of three or more by sliding the board's candy arrangements horizontally or vertically. Complete as many stages as possible before the time limit catches up with you.

pages.title: Hand Doctor
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Treat injured hands in Hand Doctor, a hospital-themed care game. Use the mouse to select and apply the available tools for your patients' injuries. Work through the treatment tasks to complete each patient's virtual medical session.

pages.title: Color Cube Jump
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Match your jumps to the path's colors in Color Cube Jump. Click the appropriate side of the screen to keep the cube progressing along the route. Collect jewels during the journey and use them to unlock additional characters.

pages.title: Color Slice 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a crowd through a colored obstacle course in Color Slice 3D. Move the group with the arrow keys and keep the characters away from hazards. The task combines navigating the colored scene with saving the people moving through it.

pages.title: School Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Form lines of matching school-themed pieces in School Match 3. Arrange three or more of the same color to score while watching the gauge at the left. Keep making useful matches before that meter drops low enough to end the game.

pages.title: Princess Eliza Going To Aquapark
pages.creator: Hexa Games
pages.description: Help a princess prepare for a water-park trip in Princess Eliza Going To Aquapark. Browse summer dresses and select a hairstyle and accessories to match. Combine the available fashion items into a finished look before she leaves for her outing.

pages.title: Robo Racing
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Robo Racing mixes vehicle races with robot battles. Drive through missions using nitro, guns, rockets, and upgrades against road enemies, then transform for larger confrontations. Manage the driving and combat together as you work to defeat the opposition.

pages.title: Abyssinian Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Piece together pictures in Abyssinian Puzzle Challenge. Choose an image and a difficulty setting, then arrange its scattered sections into the complete scene. The puzzles have no time limit, allowing you to compare shapes and solve them at your preferred pace.

pages.title: Bonnie and Friends Bollywood
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create film-inspired fashion looks in Bonnie and Friends Bollywood. Give each friend a new hairstyle, makeup, and outfit for her Bollywood ambitions. Coordinate colorful clothing with jewelry and beauty choices to complete individual looks for the group.

pages.title: Pets Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Color cats and puppies in Pets Coloring Book. Turn through the book, choose an illustration, and fill it using the available palette. Add glitter for extra decoration and save favorite drawings after finishing your version of the pet pictures.

pages.title: Annie Superhero Vs Princess
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give one character two contrasting wardrobes in Annie Superhero Vs Princess. First prepare an outfit for her superhero role, then create a princess look. Explore the clothing choices for each identity and complete both versions of her appearance.

pages.title: WormRoyale.io
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: WormRoyale.io brings worms into a battle-royale contest. Control your worm as it competes against the other contenders, with survival as the objective of the match. Try to outlast the rival worms rather than being eliminated from the competition.

pages.title: Stickman Swing Star
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Use a hook to carry a stick figure through the air in Stickman Swing Star. Control the swing and direct the character toward the finish. Mouse input handles the movement as you work on connecting the swings into a successful crossing.

pages.title: Monster Truck Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Inspect paired truck scenes in Monster Truck Differences. Find seven changes in each picture before its one-minute timer expires. Ten levels provide different monster-truck illustrations, making close comparison of small details the central task.

pages.title: Ball and Target
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Aim for a scoring zone in Ball and Target. Shoot accurately to build your total, with only three missed targets allowed. Additional obstacles appear as your score rises, making later shots more difficult to line up successfully.

pages.title: Falling Dots
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Catch falling dots that match your color in Falling Dots. Move into position for the matching targets while staying clear of differently colored ones. Keep reacting to the stream of dots as you try to raise your best score.

pages.title: Heroic Quest
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Choose a knight, berserker, or archer in Heroic Quest and fight your way through monsters. Avoid obstacles while attacking, then take on the boss. Upgrade the selected hero's abilities to make the character stronger for the battles ahead.

pages.title: Bonnie Surprise Proposal
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help organize a romantic surprise in Bonnie Surprise Proposal. Work with the would-be groom to prepare the proposal for his girlfriend. The game follows the arrangements leading up to the surprise, with your choices helping put the event together.

pages.title: Sweets Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Line up at least three matching sweets in Sweets Match 3. Score by arranging pieces of the same color while keeping an eye on the side gauge. Letting that meter fall too low ends the game, so keep finding productive matches.

pages.title: Moving Up
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide a ball upward without losing it through holes in Moving Up. Adjust the platform's movement to keep the ball steady as the route changes. Choose designed levels or try endless mode to see how far you can carry it.

pages.title: Forest Wars
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Defend woodland territory with a bow in Forest Wars. Aim and shoot arrows at the attackers threatening the forest. The game revolves around dealing with those enemies, making your mouse-controlled shots part of holding the defense together.

pages.title: Colored Shapes
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Colored Shapes asks you to match pieces by their colors, sizes, and symbols. Compare the displayed details and make the required matches as quickly as you can. More completed matches increase your score, giving you a personal total to improve.

pages.title: Princesses at Royal College
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Join student life in Princesses at Royal College, where fashion is part of the curriculum. Explore the princesses' college activities and help with their styling choices. The game frames its dress-up tasks around a school devoted to preparing fashionable royal students.

pages.title: Princess Belle Dress Up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a princess for a ballroom wedding in Princess Belle Dress Up. Choose a dress and coordinate her makeup for the event. Compare the available beauty and wardrobe options to give her a complete look for the castle celebration.
